title: Substitute
text: Replace $$x$$ with $$4x$$ in the given expansion.

title: Simplify each term
text: Since $$\left(4x\right)^2=16x^2$$, $$\left(4x\right)^3=64x^3$$ and $$\left(4x\right)^4=256x^4$$, the terms are $$1$$, $$\frac{4}{3} x$$, $$-\left(\frac{16}{9}\right) x^2$$, $$\frac{320}{81} x^3$$ and $$-\left(\frac{2560}{243}\right) x^4$$.
